name: @ts-series/settings
description: A lightweight TypeScript library that loads YAML settings and translations at runtime, plus a CLI that can pre-generate them ahead of time as statically typed code.

scripts.build:bin: rm -rf build bin && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=build/sgen.mjs && mkdir -p bin && node --build-sea sea-config.json
scripts.install:bin: pnpm run build:bin && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && install -m 755 bin/sgen ~/.local/bin/sgen
